title.original: AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite
title.zh: AstaBench：使用科学研究套件对人工智能代理进行严格的基准测试
title.en: AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite

inclusion_reason.zh: AstaBench 提供受控科研工具环境、统一 Agent 接口、真实任务和分阶段评分，可复用于科学 Agent 的严谨比较。
inclusion_reason.en: AstaBench supplies controlled research tools, a common agent interface, realistic tasks, and stage-specific scoring for rigorous reusable comparison of science agents.

abstract.zh: AstaBench 是覆盖科学发现全过程的 Agent 评测套件，配套生产级搜索环境、标准接口、科学专用 Agent 与多层基线。
abstract.en: AstaBench evaluates agents across the scientific-discovery lifecycle with production-grade search tools, standardized interfaces, science-focused agents, and layered baselines.

problem.zh: 科学 Agent 基准常缺可复现工具，无法控制模型成本和访问权限等混杂因素，也缺少贴近真实科研请求的整体任务。
problem.en: Scientific-agent benchmarks often lack reproducible tools, fail to control cost and access confounders, and omit holistic tasks reflecting real research requests.

approach.zh: 作者按严谨评测原则构建跨学科问题集和受控搜索环境，并用多类 Asta Agent、通用 Agent 与基线进行广泛比较。
approach.en: The authors build a cross-domain problem suite and controlled search environment under rigorous evaluation principles, then compare many Asta, general, and baseline agents.

system_design.zh: 套件统一任务模式、搜索与科研工具 API、成本和工具权限配置、执行记录及分阶段科学能力评分。
system_design.en: The suite unifies task schemas, search and science-tool APIs, cost/access configurations, execution logging, and stage-specific scientific capability scoring.

key_results.zh: 广泛评测显示 Agent 在部分科研子能力上已有进展，但尚不能稳定完成端到端科学研究辅助。
key_results.en: Broad evaluation shows progress on selected scientific sub-capabilities while agents remain far from reliable end-to-end research assistance.

limitations.zh: 生产级搜索仍是特定工具实现，自动评分难覆盖新颖性和科学有效性；实际科研还包含长期协作、实验设施和伦理审查。
limitations.en: Production-grade search is still one tool stack, automated scoring cannot fully assess novelty or scientific validity, and real research includes long collaboration, laboratories, and ethics.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
